note: The Bank of Abyssinia's banking services charges: its branch banking charges are for withdrawals, transfers, statements and confirmations, with nothing for keeping a savings account; the 2.50 birr a month is its mobile banking service's maintenance fee, which the game doesn't count.

sources.title: Bank of Abyssinia, Tariffs: Banking Services Charges
sources.said: Bank of Abyssinia Banking Services Charges ... Branch Banking ... Cash Withdrawal ... Free ... Up to Birr 2000 ... Digital Banking ... 1. BOA mobile/internet banking ... Maintenance fee ... Birr 2.50 per month, plus applicable VAT and Disaster Fund.
